lines.text: Nahum the Elkoshite sees a vision against Nineveh, describing the LORD as slow to anger and great in power.
The LORD dries up the sea and rivers, the mountains quake, and even rocks are shattered before Him.
The LORD is a stronghold for those who trust in Him, but a drought will make an end of Nineveh.
Affliction will not rise up a second time, and the LORD will break the yoke from Israel's neck.
The LORD will prepare Nineveh's grave, and Judah is told to celebrate its feasts and fulfill its vows.
